found: Coursed limestone ashlar on the recipe's own 8 courses of 4 blocks in half bond, with the joints and arrises where the structure puts them. Grey white blocks with green algae down the joints, dense black spotting in patches and small shell inclusions. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature, watermark or mason's mark anywhere in the four crops, and nothing that reads as a particular real building.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
